title: Shipping Fee
statement: Write a function `shippingFee(weight)` that calculates fee: weight up to 2 kg pays 50, weight up to 10 kg pays 100, and over 10 kg pays 200.
example: shippingFee(1) returns 50; shippingFee(5) returns 100; shippingFee(15) returns 200.
prewrittenHints: Check the package weight against each tier.
Use conditional statements to test if weight is at most two or ten.
Give back fifty for light parcels, one hundred for medium, or two hundred for heavy.
conceptNote: Order conditions from smallest range to largest range.
